library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-discovery-core holds the discovery SPI: DiscoveryClient, ServiceInstance, ServiceInstanceList and static or configuration-based instance lists. It also holds the related health and registration types. Tests can build these objects directly or through a plain Micronaut ApplicationContext, so no network service is needed. The sibling io.micronaut tests here (micronaut-core, micronaut-router, micronaut-management) work with the standard scaffold. I did not resolve the artifact's POM or read its documentation, so this rests on my knowledge of the library and on those siblings.
risks: I did not open the artifact or check its dependencies. If the resolved POM leaves a Micronaut runtime dependency (e.g. micronaut-context or micronaut-http) off the test classpath, add it as a testImplementation dependency matching 5.1.10.
Consul, Eureka and Kubernetes discovery clients live in separate modules. Do not pull them in or add Docker images for them.
